evidence.alignment: All five technologies target high-growth semiconductor segments (advanced logic, heterogeneous integration, AI-driven fabs, and near-memory compute) that are well-aligned with 2027-2030 market booms; no declining or saturated technologies are included.
evidence.sequencing: Dependency chains are fully respected (T01→T02→T03) with zero violations, and TRL-based lead times are plausible, though hybrid bonding packaging completes in 2030-Q1 while its market boom peaked in 2027-Q4, indicating a 2.25-year lag that weakens first-mover positioning.
evidence.investment: The three core process/packaging technologies (T01, T02, T03) correctly receive Strategic tier investment matching their high market opportunity and strategic fit scores; AI process control (T04) is appropriately placed at High tier; CiM (T05) at Medium tier reflects its low TRL and high uncertainty.
evidence.coherence: The five technologies form a coherent vertical stack from advanced transistor architecture (GAA) through power delivery (backside PDN) to advanced packaging (hybrid bonding), supported by AI process control and a forward-looking CiM bet—representing a complete IDM/foundry capability narrative from research to deployment.
evidence.balance: All three Strategic investments are concentrated in a single process-packaging value chain, creating tier concentration risk; there are no Exploratory or Low-tier technologies, and the portfolio skews heavily toward near-term process bets with only one genuine long-horizon (CiM) technology.

strengths: Zero dependency violations with a logically sequenced T01→T02→T03 process-packaging stack that mirrors real-world semiconductor development progression.
Investment tiers are well-calibrated to quantitative scores: Strategic for high market_opp/strategic_fit technologies, Medium for the high-uncertainty CiM architecture.
weaknesses: Hybrid bonding packaging (T03) finishes 2.25 years after its market boom (2027-Q4 vs 2030-Q1 completion), risking late market entry and loss of first-mover advantage in advanced packaging.
Portfolio tier diversity is low—three Strategic, one High, one Medium, and nothing at Exploratory or Low—concentrating investment risk in a single sequential technology chain.
missing_technologies: EUV High-NA lithography (enabling sub-2nm patterning complementary to GAA)
Chiplet interconnect standards / UCIe IP (critical for heterogeneous integration alongside hybrid bonding)
Advanced thermal management / embedded cooling (necessary for high-density GAA + backside PDN integration)
investment_issues: Three Strategic-tier investments in a strictly sequential chain (T01→T02→T03) mean that any execution slip in T01 cascades to delay all downstream Strategic investments simultaneously, concentrating both financial and schedule risk.

No budget is allocated to exploratory or diversification technologies outside the core logic-packaging stack, leaving the portfolio exposed if the GAA-centric roadmap faces disruption (e.g., alternative device architectures like CFET).
timing_issues: 하이브리드 본딩 패키징 completes in 2030-Q1 but market boom is 2027-Q4, a 2.25-year miss—the start date should be pulled forward or the dependency chain compressed to capture peak demand.
Backside 전력망 형성 기술 also lags its boom by 1.0 year (completes 2029-Q1 vs boom 2028-Q1), compounded by its dependency on T01 which itself runs 0.75 years late relative to its boom.
